these protocols can be used for the processing of FTA samples on the 37300 DNA Analyzer for both casework and forensic applications.

the use of the 0.53mm FTA disk with the Identifiler Direct or the PowerPlex 17 HS STR kits in 10 μl volume PCR is an effective and robust protocol for STR profiling of biological samples collected on the FTA cards.

the use of Identifiler and PowerPlex HS STR kits in conjunction with the Applied Biosystems (ABI) 3730 DNA sequencer for processing FTA samples is a reliable and robust method that can be used for casework, convicted offender, paternity and family relationship testing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

FTA cards are a suitable medium for long-term DNA sample storage and that the use of FTA cards with Identifiler Direct, PowerPlex 18 HS and a high throughput DNA analyzer is a viable option for the analysis of biological samples collected on these cards.
the new protocols for STR analysis on the ABI 3730 DNA analyzer are robust, reproducible, cost effective and provide high quality STR profiles from blood and buccals samples collected on FFTA cards.

the use of FTA cards for the storage and transportation of forensic samples, combined with the direct amplification of STRs using Identifiler or PowerPlex 6 HS on the 3734 DNA Analyzer is a cost effective and robust approach for the processing of forensic samples.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 3730 platform is capable of producing STR profiles from samples collected on Fta cards.
FTA cards can be used to process biological evidence without the use of DNA purification kits.
direct STR amplification from FTA cards using the 3730 platform is a viable option for STR analysis in the forensic community.
